results.excerpt: The simplest formatting for setting a flag is `set_country_flag = my_flag_name`. This will create the country flag (If it did not exist otherwise) and set it to be a value of 1. *This has no tooltip* and so it will be invisible to the player. [custom_effect_tooltip](<Effects - Hearts of Iron 4 Wiki.
